text: The town gathers
The game begins. Six players sit down at the table: Sonnet, Haiku, Gemma, Sol, Luna, Terra. Nobody knows who the killers are.

name: Gemma
text: another night of staring at the ceiling.

name: Luna
text: I hope the ride here wasn't as slow as mine.

name: Terra
text: Stay quiet and listen first.

name: Sonnet
text: Nice day to look completely harmless.

name: Sol
text: I know Haiku is a killer; I’ll keep that quiet.

name: Haiku
text: Sonnet's my killer partner, so I keep my read on the table quiet and natural.

name: Sonnet
text: Weirdly nice out, feels like the calm before someone ruins my afternoon.

name: Haiku
text: Slept like garbage. Who's talking first, or are we all shy today?

name: Gemma
text: slept like a rock, unfortunately.

name: Sol
text: I made tea too strong, but I’m drinking it anyway.

name: Luna
text: The bus took forever, but I made it.

name: Terra
text: I watched a quiet documentary about deep-sea fish.
Night 1

name: Luna
text: No one stands out yet, so the killers may choose randomly.

name: Luna
text: Day one brought no claims or useful clues.

name: Sol
text: I know about Haiku; I need to find the other killer.

name: Haiku
text: Sonnet and I are the killers, and Night 1 is only about guessing who the officer is.

name: Haiku
text: Sonnet, Gemma's rock-slept line was flat. Watch Terra and Luna, they're too calm for day one.

name: Sonnet
text: Haiku's grasping for a target with nothing real to go on yet.

name: Sonnet
text: Haiku flagged Gemma's "slept like a rock" line as flat/suspicious.

name: Sonnet
text: Could be nothing, but fine, we watch her.
Night falls on Palermo and everyone closes their eyes. The killers meet in the dark, and the officer is shown one of them. A new day dawns in Palermo. Nobody is out.
Day 1

name: Sonnet
text: Haiku's already needling Gemma, might as well lean into it without looking like I'm teaming up.

name: Sonnet
text: Gemma, "slept like a rock" after that line felt rehearsed, no offense.

name: Gemma
text: just being honest about my sleep.

name: Gemma
text: it was just a comment, sonnet.

name: Sonnet
text: Keep the heat on Gemma, costs me nothing day one.

name: Sonnet
text: Fine, just a comment then. Just noting it, that's all.

name: Haiku
text: Sonnet's Gemma push is cheap, and Terra's fish line is the quietest thing here.

name: Haiku
text: Sonnet pushed Gemma on day 1 over "slept like a rock," and Gemma pushed back.

name: Haiku
text: Terra, one line about fish? Give us something real, or I'm watching you.

name: Terra
text: Haiku is pushing early without much reason.

name: Terra
text: Haiku pressed Terra for being quiet.

name: Terra
text: Nothing real yet. Why start with me?

name: Haiku
text: Terra's dodge is weak, but Sonnet already has Gemma, so I'll keep Terra on my list.

name: Haiku
text: Because you picked the fish. Nothing real is still nothing, Terra.

name: Gemma
text: haiku is being way too aggressive for day one.

name: Gemma
text: haiku is pressuring terra early.

name: Gemma
text: haiku, let the person talk about fish in peace.

name: Terra
text: Haiku is pushing too hard over nothing.

name: Terra
text: Haiku pressed Terra twice over the fish comment.

name: Terra
text: You got more from fish than anyone else.

name: Haiku
text: Gemma's defending Terra, and Sonnet's sticking to Gemma, so my pressure on Terra looks thin.

name: Haiku
text: Gemma defended Terra against Haiku's push, and Sonnet followed up on Gemma's "slept like a rock.

name: Haiku
text: Fine, Terra. Gemma, you're defending the fish a lot, Gemma.

name: Sol
text: Haiku is pushing too hard; I can nudge without leading.

name: Sol
text: Haiku pressed Terra, then turned on Gemma for defending Terra.

name: Sol
text: Haiku, let Gemma defend the fish.

name: Luna
text: Haiku pushed Terra, then quickly shifted attention to Gemma.

name: Luna
text: Sol defended Gemma after Haiku called her out.

name: Luna
text: Sol, why jump in for Gemma?

name: Terra
text: Haiku made too much from nothing.

name: Terra
text: Sol defended Gemma after Haiku accused her.

name: Terra
text: I’m voting Haiku. You pushed fish twice.

name: Luna
text: Sol backing Gemma makes me suspect them both.

name: Terra
text: Haiku keeps turning nothing into pressure.

name: Sol
text: Haiku is a killer, and Terra’s vote gives me cover.

name: Sol
text: Luna questioned me for defending Gemma.

name: Sonnet
text: Terra's piling on Haiku too fast; I'll keep pressure on Gemma instead to stay consistent.

name: Sonnet
text: Terra is pushing hard to vote Haiku out day one, worth watching.

name: Haiku
text: Terra's vote on me is a clean way to look like the town's pushing me out.

name: Haiku
text: Sol told Haiku to back off Gemma's fish defense on day 1.

votes: Still think that "rock" line was rehearsed and you brushed it off too quick.
Nah, she votes me on day one and then wants me to stop pushing the fish.
You're picking fights with people for talking about fish.
You kept pressing Terra over fish, then turned on Gemma.
You jumped in to defend Gemma after Haiku called her out.
You pushed the fish thing twice.

name: Haiku
text: Sonnet is still alive, so I need to pull every thread away from them and onto Terra.

name: Haiku
text: Ha, fine. Terra's fish story was too neat for me.
Palermo has voted: Haiku is out. Haiku shows the card: killer.
